meta.name: Its A Wonderful Knife
meta.description: Winnie's life is less than wonderful one year after saving her town from a psychotic killer on Christmas Eve. When she wishes she was never born, she finds herself magically transported to a nightmarish parallel universe. With the murderous maniac now back, she must team up with a misfit to identify the culprit and get back to her own reality.
meta.slogan: This Christmas, your wishes will come true... and your nightmares too.
